category_title: Middle school students with IDD who independently navigate UDL literacy environments using audio supports and social features
scenario_title: Spelling and mechanics difficulties during online commenting
minimal_context: The student is working independently in the Udio platform to write a comment on an article.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please write a comment on the article you just finished reading in Udio.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Selects the text response option) I'm going to type my comment for this article.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Clicks on the embedded supports) I'll use one of the sentence starters to help me begin my response.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops typing) I need help. How do you spell this word? And I don't know where the capital letters and periods go.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please write a comment on the article you just finished reading in Udio.

STUDENT: (Selects the text response option) I'm going to type my comment for this article.

TUTOR: Go ahead and start.

STUDENT: (Clicks on the embedded supports) I'll use one of the sentence starters to help me begin my response.

TUTOR: Keep going.

STUDENT: (Stops typing) I need help. How do you spell this word? And I don't know where the capital letters and periods go.

task.content: Writing comments on articles and projects
task.learning_goal: Interact and engage with the text

context.environment: Classroom sessions using Udio, an online UDL literacy environment
context.materials: Udio platform, sentence starters, text, draw, and audiorecord response options
context.social_setting: Working independently on literacy tasks in Udio during classroom sessions
context.time_context: 20-minute reading sessions three times a week

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Encountering difficulties with spelling or mechanical aspects of writing while using the Udio platform
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Initiated requests for adult support primarily about spelling or mechanics

behavior_patterns.condition: When commenting on articles and projects
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Used all three response options (text, draw, and audiorecord) to comment
